integrity: Mathematical proof reconstructed and supported by exact rational and independent finite numerical checks; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric stochastic transition matrices with uniform stationary measure only; no classification of all non-invariant optimizer matrices.

Previously known complete-bipartite solution covers the optimal-value branch when the independent class has at least as many vertices as the core; the new mathematical content is the entire complete-split classification, in particular the mandatory clique-edge regime.
Novelty relative to specialized less-indexed papers is uncertain. Numerical tests are not proofs of the universal statement.
title: Two sharp edge-use transitions in fastest mixing on complete split graphs
